## For translation PRs

- [ ] Filename follows BCP 47 convention (e.g., `README.es.md`, `MANIFESTO.zh-CN.md`)
- [ ] Language switcher line added at the top of the translated file
- [ ] Reciprocal link added in the canonical English file
- [ ] Technical terms kept in English where appropriate (`token`, `story points`, `spike`, `merge`, etc.)
- [ ] Currency stays in USD (not converted)

## For methodology PRs

Methodology changes (sizing buckets, pillars, anti-patterns) are higher-bar than docs changes. Please confirm:

- [ ] I opened an issue first to discuss the change
- [ ] I've read the [Manifesto](MANIFESTO.md) and my proposal doesn't contradict the 6 pillars (or, if it does, I've explicitly addressed why)
- [ ] I've considered whether this change would benefit from community calibration data first

- [ ] If I added new files, I've followed the existing naming and structure conventions
- [ ] I'm okay with this contribution being licensed under CC BY 4.0 (same as the rest of the repo)
